mapper.sql: o.pay_order_id, o.out_trade_no, o.recharge_id, o.member_id, m.phone, o.provider_code, p.provider_name, o.channel_code, ifnull(nullif(c.display_name,''), c.channel_name) as channelName, o.product_id, o.currency, o.amount, o.provider_amount, o.status, o.pay_type, o.pay_url, o.provider_trade_no, o.notify_payload, o.expire_time, o.paid_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, o.remark, p.mock_mode
mapper.select: select from biz_pay_order o left join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id left join biz_pay_provider p on p.provider_code = o.provider_code left join biz_pay_channel c on c.channel_code = o.channel_code where o.pay_order_id = #{payOrderId}

select from biz_pay_order o left join biz_member m on m.member_id = o.member_id left join biz_pay_provider p on p.provider_code = o.provider_code left join biz_pay_channel c on c.channel_code = o.channel_code where o.out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}

select pay_order_id, out_trade_no, recharge_id, member_id, provider_code, channel_code, product_id, currency, amount, provider_amount, status, pay_type, pay_url, provider_trade_no, notify_payload, expire_time, paid_time, create_time, update_time, remark from biz_pay_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} for update
